name: The nap at a night's lock sleeps at once, until you unlock
case: At night, the person locks the Mac with an agent's thread sitting idle, and Boop takes its nap. It's asleep at once, as Doing says, not after the usual doze. A short unlock wakes it.
why: Boop sleeps at once, and the dream follows by itself. Core.nap holds it, so no Jev is needed
